- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, step "Enable auto-merge on PR" (env wiring at line 5932) together with scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh lines 42-46
  PROBLEM: INITIAL_HEAD_SHA is only captured in the "Checkout PR head branch" step's CAN_PUSH=true branch (line 2753). For fork PRs (HEAD_REPO != github.repository, line 2687-2690) and for head refs rejected by the branch-pattern guards (lines 2676-2685), the step exits early with CAN_PUSH=false and INITIAL_HEAD_SHA is never written to GITHUB_ENV. The "Enable auto-merge on PR" step is NOT gated on CAN_PUSH (its `if` at line 5919 has no CAN_PUSH condition), so for every fork PR the helper now receives an empty AUTO_MERGE_EXPECTED_HEAD_SHA and takes the new refuse branch at review_enable_auto_merge.sh:42-46 on every run, forever.
  WHY: before this PR, a clean review of a fork PR enabled auto-merge (the GH_PAT can merge fork PRs; merge is a repo-level operation, not a push to the fork). After this PR, auto-merge on fork PRs is permanently refused — not "recoverable on the next sync event" as the warning claims, because no future run will ever have INITIAL_HEAD_SHA set on the fork path. Fork PRs in every consumer repo silently lose auto-merge. Suggested minimal fix: when INITIAL_HEAD_SHA is empty (CAN_PUSH=false), fall back to the PR head OID already available in PR_META_FILE (headRefOid) or the gate's head_sha output, rather than refusing.
  severity=high
